title: gentiana strictiflora
intro: Gentiana strictiflora, commonly known as Alpine gentian, is a species of flowering plant in the Gentianaceae family. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can help alleviate digestive issues and respiratory problems. The therapeutic actions of Alpine gentian include stimulating the appetite, improving digestion, and exhibiting expectorant properties, making it a potential treatment for coughs and colds. The bioactive constituents of this plant include gentiopicroside, amarogentin, and gentisin, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
